candidates.change_summary: Remove the owner check so anyone can drain the contract's balance via withdraw().
Send only msg.value instead of the full contract balance in withdraw().
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw() no longer sends any funds.
Remove the require(msg.sender == Owner) access-control check so anyone can call Command.
Invert the ownership check so Command succeeds only for non-owners.
Forward the entire contract balance instead of msg.value to the target address.
Replace the low-level call with a transfer of msg.value to adr, discarding the calldata payload.
Remove the if guard so the transfer executes on every call instead of only when msg.value >= contract balance.
Change the strict >= comparison to > so the branch no longer triggers when msg.value equals the contract balance.
Transfer only msg.value instead of the full balance plus msg.value, leaving the rest of the contract's funds in place.
Delete the transfer statement so no funds are sent out when the condition holds.
